Name: Give Me My Cursor Back
Author: DecidedlyHuman
Description:
[img]https://img.shields.io/github/license/DecidedlyHuman/GiveMeMyCursorBack[/img]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/79440738-1763029182.png[/img]
This mod will make it so that, when you're alt tabbed (and don't have the hardware cursor setting toggled on), you can [i]see your cursor when it's over the Stardew Valley window[/i].

Dark sorcery, yes, but it's always annoyed me. Then, I realised, I can fairly easily fix it. And so, now you get to benefit from it!

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/79440738-1772988167.png[/img]
Just install the mod! It has GMCM support for you to configure how many game ticks it waits before it checks to do the wizardry. This is purely to alleviate potential minor performance issues.

[i]Please note: [/i]This mod, inherently, takes control of your game's hardware cursor setting at the core of how it works. This is unavoidable. If somebody requests it, I could have it remember the initial setting, and set it back to what that was on exit.

[b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/79440738-1763028878.png[/img][/b]
1.0.2 — Fixed a couple of bugs with events, and donating to the museum.

[b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/79440738-1763029577.png[/img][/b]
Currently tested on Stardew Valley 1.5.4 with SMAPI 3.12.7 on Windows. I don't anticipate failures on OS X or Linux, but let me know if you have issues.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/79440738-1763029247.png[/img]
